build_radial_mlp: build a RadialMLP neural network with a list of channel sizes for radial basis function processing
create_polynomial_envelope: create a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent for smooth cutoff of radial distances
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to embed distances into a Gaussian basis representation
test_gaussian_function: test the JIT-compiled gaussian function that computes Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
review_polynomial_envelope_forward: review the PolynomialEnvelope forward method that applies a polynomial envelope with smooth cutoff at d_scaled equals 1
